entries.title: Psalms 39:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker. Of Jeduthun. A Psalm. Of David.> I said, I will give attention to my ways, so that my tongue may do no wrong; I will keep my mouth under control, while the sinner is before me.

entries.title: Psalms 39:2
segments: I made no sound, I said no word, even of good; and I was moved with sorrow.

entries.title: Psalms 39:3
segments: My heart was burning in my breast; while I was deep in thought the fire was lighted; then I said with my tongue,

entries.title: Psalms 39:4
segments: Lord, give me knowledge of my end, and of the measure of my days, so that I may see how feeble I am.

entries.title: Psalms 39:5
segments: You have made my days no longer than a hand's measure; and my years are nothing in your eyes; truly, every man is but a breath. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 39:6
segments: Truly, every man goes on his way like an image; he is troubled for no purpose: he makes a great store of wealth, and has no knowledge of who will get it.

entries.title: Psalms 39:7
segments: ¶And now, Lord, what am I waiting for? my hope is in you.

entries.title: Psalms 39:8
segments: Make me free from all my sins; do not let me be shamed by the man of evil behaviour.

entries.title: Psalms 39:9
segments: I was quiet, and kept my mouth shut; because you had done it.

entries.title: Psalms 39:10
segments: No longer let your hand be hard on me; I am wasted by the blows of your hand.

entries.title: Psalms 39:11
segments: By the weight of your wrath against man's sin, the glory of his form is wasted away; truly every man is but a breath. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 39:12
segments: Let my prayer come to your ears, O Lord, and give attention to my cry, make an answer to my weeping: for my time here is short before you, and in a little time I will be gone, like all my fathers.

entries.title: Psalms 39:13
segments: Let your wrath be turned away from me, so that I may be comforted, before I go away from here, and become nothing.
